description:
Booking Wolf helps travellers find and book hotels, tours and activities. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, your dates and how many people, and you get real options with prices, photos, ratings and what's included.

For a hotel you see the rate for your dates, and alongside it the prices publicly listed for the same room on other travel sites, so you can see what the room costs before deciding. First-time guests also see the credit their booking earns towards a future stay.

For tours and activities you see the price, what the day involves, and whether the tour actually runs on the date you asked about.

When you pick something, the booking link takes you to bookingwolf.com to finish on our secure checkout.

defaultPrompt: Where can I get the cheapest hotel in Bangkok for two nights in March?
Book me a Mount Batur sunrise trek in Bali - what's bookable and what does it cost?
What would a hotel in Tokyo cost for two nights in March, and what credit would I earn towards my next trip?
